one_line: 15th‑century Tripura king who patronised the Rajmala chronicle, sacred tanks, and campaigns on the Bengal–Arakan frontier.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height, sturdy but not bulky build, with the presence of a seasoned yet thoughtful ruler.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, intelligent gaze; medium‑brown complexion with a slight warm undertone; straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache, faint stubble along the jaw, and a small tilak of red vermilion on the forehead; default expression is composed and resolute, with a hint of scholarly curiosity.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a neat topknot at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothed back; he wears a simple gold circlet‑style mukut band with a small central lotus motif and no tall crest, keeping the silhouette low and practical.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee‑length cotton angarkha‑style tunic in deep maroon, overlapping and tied at the right side with narrow ties, its borders edged with a thin gold woven trim; over this, a soft off‑white cotton dhoti wrapped in the eastern style with neat pleats in front and tucked securely at the waist, falling to the ankles; around his waist is a broad dark‑green cloth belt (patka) with subtle diagonal gold thread lines, the ends hanging at his left hip; draped over his left shoulder and around his back is a light cream‑coloured cotton uttariya with a fine red border, worn like a royal shawl; he has simple gold stud earrings, a single medium‑thickness gold bangle on each wrist, and a beaded tulsi‑style neck mala paired with a flat rectangular gold pendant; his feet wear plain brown leather sandals with a toe loop, practical for both court and campaign.
appearance.signature: A straight, slightly broad‑bladed Indian sword (talwar prototype) with a gently curving single‑edged steel blade, a plain brass hilt with a disc pommel and no ornate guard, carried in a brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings and worn suspended from his left hip.

ref_desc: Dharma Manikya I is a medium‑brown, oval‑faced king in his early 40s with a black topknot, gold circlet, neat moustache, wearing a deep maroon angarkha over an off‑white dhoti, cream uttariya, dark‑green waist cloth, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a plain‑hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Dharma Manikya I, a 15th‑century Tripura king: a medium‑brown man in his early 40s, oval face, thoughtful eyes, neat black moustache and faint jaw stubble, with thick black hair gathered into a tidy topknot and a simple low gold circlet with a small central lotus motif. Show him in a deep maroon knee‑length angarkha‑style tunic with gold edging over an off‑white ankle‑length dhoti wrapped eastern‑style, a broad dark‑green cloth belt with subtle diagonal gold lines tied at the waist, and a cream cotton uttariya with a fine red border draped over his left shoulder and around his back. Include small gold stud earrings, a tulsi‑style bead necklace with a flat rectangular gold pendant, one gold bangle on each wrist, and plain brown leather sandals. At his left hip, show a brown leather‑sheathed Indian sword with a gently curving blade and simple brass hilt and disc pommel, positioned so the weapon is clearly visible. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, cream, off‑white, dark green, and gold, and present him from multiple angles and poses to clearly display face, hair, costume, jewellery, and sword for consistent redrawing.
